QuestInfo.name: Pyramid Treasures
QuestInfo.0: Slyn found a new way to make money. This was Alpha and Beta's chance to strike it big!
QuestInfo.1: Slyn is sure the pyramid is full of treasure. But he cannot enter because the pyramid holds too many dangers. Slyn promises you that he will share all profits from what he finds in the pyramid 50 / 50 with you if you would go and eliminate the  #r#o2600120##k and #r#o2600122##k.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta eliminate the monsters in the Pyramid, but they had to wait a DECADE for a return on their investment? Did they just get scammed?!

0.0: Have you heard of the Pyramid? It's the grave of an ancient king. It positively crawls with booby traps and monsters. Do you see where I'm getting at? \r\n#L0##bUh, no?#l\n#k
0.1: Ancient civilizations are known to bury wealth with their dead. I smell treasure. Are you with me?

yes.0: Get into the Pyramid, and get rid of anything dangerous. I'll go behind you with the excavation, and we can divvy up half the profits at the end! What do you say? Interested?
yes.1: Then eliminate #r18#k #r#o2600120##k and #r#o2600122##k monsters! They are guarding the pyramid.

no.0: Don't you know the foundations of investing? High risks for high rewards!

1.0: Have you finished your job at the pyramid?

yes.0: Excellent. I'll send a group to excavate the inner pyramid. Keep in mind, it'll take at least ten years before we see a return on our investment. Come see me then!

default.0: While you take care of #r18#k #r#o2600120##k and #r#o2600122##k monsters, I'll start the footwork for the business side of things. Of course, we'll split our profits fifty-fifty.
